extracted.intended_audience: researchers, potential proposers, industry partners, investors, entrepreneurs, and others seeking to engage with ARPA-H or learn about ARPA-H events
extracted.subtask_description: Information for engaging with ARPA-H via events (Proposers' Days, trainings, industry days, conferences) to learn the agency vision, application processes, and opportunities for collaboration and funding. Includes registration instructions, eligibility notes for trainings, and topical areas of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposers' Day: reference Special Notice on SAM.gov and register via ARPA-H Solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: For Proposers' Day events, reference the program's Special Notice on SAM.gov for event details and then visit the ARPA-H Solutions site to register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the program's Special Notice on SAM.gov as the authoritative source for event details; registration is handled through the ARPA-H Solutions site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speaking engagement requests procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: For speaking engagement requests, please fill out the engagements form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests must be submitted through the specified engagements form (no other submission route described).

rubrics_metrics.name: OT training eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-H Comprehensive Other Transaction (OT) training event is open to government and industry personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Event is available to both government and industry attendees; some OT trainings are restricted (e.g., a later virtual course noted as open to federal employees only).

rubrics_metrics.name: OT training registration limits and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Registration for OT training events is limited (example: limited to 500 attendees; events have registration open/close dates).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attendees will receive event invites and course information upon successful registration; some events reach capacity and registration closes early — monitor registration announcements and deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: OT training learning outcomes/topics
rubrics_metrics.description: Major topics for Comprehensive OT training include business approaches, payable milestones, teaming, intellectual property, and an overview of OT authorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The course offers substantive coverage of OT-related business and legal topics and may provide training credit (example: 12 hours).

rubrics_metrics.name: OT training credit
rubrics_metrics.description: The Comprehensive OT course offers attendees a chance to earn 12 hours of training credit (for at least one listed instance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific credit hours may be advertised for particular offerings; check event details for confirmation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration deadlines and explicit close times
rubrics_metrics.description: Many events (Proposers' Days, virtual events, hybrid events) specify registration closes at precise dates/times (e.g., in-person registration closes 5 PM ET on X date; virtual registration closes 5 PM ET on Y date).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attendees must observe the stated deadlines; late registration is not implied as available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry Day purpose and recommended attendee actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Doing Business with ARPA-H Industry Day aims to provide tips, tricks, and lessons learned about how to successfully locate and apply for research and development funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participants should attend sessions, ask questions, engage in informal conversations with staff across the agency, and expect in-depth information about the ARPA-H business model.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposers' Day / Open BAA role in application guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposers' Day events outline the agency’s vision and provide detailed information about the application process for solicitations (e.g., Open BAA), inviting participants to learn about the funding model and ask questions of senior leadership.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attending Proposers' Day is presented as a recommended way to understand application requirements, the awards process, and the agency’s priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Channels for additional resources (OT Community and event recordings)
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-H points attendees to additional resources such as ARPA-H's OT Community for OT resources, reports, and templates, and posts recordings/photos/videos of past events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you miss an event or want deeper materials, consult the OT Community or view posted recordings and photos linked from event pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topics and thematic areas of ARPA-H interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Events and meeting invitations indicate ARPA-H interest in areas such as gene therapies, regenerative medicine, fertility care, manufacturing and precision medicine, 3D bioprinting, generative AI drug discovery, cellular therapies, and areas like women's health and cancer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your work aligns with these thematic areas, ARPA-H encourages requesting meetings with Program Managers or attending relevant sessions to discuss transformative ideas and potential collaborations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meeting requests with Program Managers
rubrics_metrics.description: For certain events (e.g., BIO InTernational Convention 2026), ARPA-H invites individuals working on cutting-edge relevant topics to request a meeting to speak with Program Managers about transformative ideas and potential collaborations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'Meet with Us' or meeting-request mechanisms when available to seek direct engagement; meetings are positioned as a pathway to explore fit and collaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event-specific audience restrictions noted
rubrics_metrics.description: Some ARPA-H events are targeted to specific audiences (examples: an OT training open to government and industry; another OT training free and open to federal employees only).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check each event's audience eligibility before registering; eligibility affects who may attend and who may receive training credit.

rubrics_metrics.name: ARPA-H business model and milestone-based funding
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-H emphasizes its unique, milestone-based funding model and streamlined business practices; events and panels cover how this model accelerates breakthrough solutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective proposers should learn about milestone-based award structures and ARPA-H's streamlined contracting approaches when preparing to engage or apply.
